mate I'm sorry I went quiet. you said you're not ok and I should've got back to you properly. you don't need to apologise for anything. ceiling on your bed, all your gear and your song notebooks gone, then that portal bullshit from the landlord. he's a grub. that's a massive amount to cop and you're not dealing with the rest of it on your own.

also Tully's been onto Dee at the Lantern Room about a benefit night. she's offered Sat the 28th, all door money to you, and Hollow Pines are keen to play too. nothing you need to organise or perform at. if you're up for it we can handle it. please don't call time on Brisbane or the band this week. if Rocky's what you want once you've had a bit of breathing room, I'll listen, but don't let this shit make the decision for you. your songs are the best thing about our band. you don't owe us rehearsal Thursday or anything else right now.

you drove to bloody Gatton at 2am when my car died after that Toowoomba gig and didn't even whinge. you don't have to earn the same back, mate. we're here.

what time should I come round tomorrow?
